name: Quechua 2 Seconds, 2-person pop-up tent (Decathlon model 340082, ref. 8755225)
note: Decathlon publishes only the bedroom floor (120 x 210 cm, official drawing; heights 102 cm front / 82 cm rear) and a ground surface of 3.2 m2 - no outer length/width.
